abstract_summary: Autonomous agents that run ML experiments are usually judged by the best score they reach. That score says nothing about how it was reached: whether the agent stayed within the files it was allowed to edit, whether failed trials were kept or silently dropped, and whether each keep or discard decision can be traced t...

scholarly_quality.concise_summary: The paper provides an exceptionally rigorous, well-engineered, and transparently characterized framework for auditing autonomous ML experimentation agents. By focusing on governance, auditability, and failure classification rather than merely reporting peak task scores, it makes a substantial methodological contribution supported by solid empirical evidence and reproducible open artifacts.

one bounded change per trial; a worker
applies it and runs training; and a control plane owns everything
else: the trial's lifecycle, the check that the patch touches only ed-
itable files, metric parsing, the keep or discard decision, and one
append-only ledger record per trial, written whatever the outcome.
None of these is delegated to the agent, so the manager can be
replaced without changing what is recorded. From the ledger we
compute six governance metrics alongside the task metric: accep-
tance rate, invalid-action rate, repeated-bad rate, provenance com-
pleteness, artifact-reference completeness, and a failure taxonomy
(Section 4.4).

tific trigger task, and GPT pretraining. Four

ant:
For every budget slot that entersexecuting, the con-
trol plane appends exactly one terminal record—kept,
discarded, orfailed_invalid—to the append-only
ledger before the next slot may open. No slot is silently
skipped; no slot produces more than one record; no record
is overwritten or deleted.
Enforcement has two paths.Normal path:the pending guard is
written before the worker starts and deleted on the terminal transi-
tion; any deviation raises an error before the ledger append.Crash-
recovery path:if the process crashes mid-trial, the guard file per-
sists; at the next campaign startPendingTrialErroris raised, the
stale guard is inspected viascripts/recover_pending.py, and a
failed_invalidrecord is appended before any new trial begins.
Neither path allows a budget slot to close without a ledger record.
The invariant is structural rather than empirical: it holds by

loop is bounded, auditable, failure-aware, reproducible, and behav-
iorally affected by governance memory. Governance metrics are
primary; task-metric AUC is secondary evidence that the loop runs
end-to-end.

missing_information: No reproducible review or selection methodology was detected.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: An independent rule-based relabeler applied to observable ledger fields achieved Cohen's kappa 0.830 against control-plane failure labels, and matched ungoverned counterfactual campaigns corroborate the ledger-completeness loss claim.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Governance metrics computed from the append-only ledger (provenance completeness, invalid rate, failure taxonomy) and matched governed-versus-ungoverned ledger completeness.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The control plane's deterministic keep/discard rule uses parsed task metrics against the current best, while the manager's proposals are shaped by memory context and the repeated-bad detector.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims are carefully scoped: governance and provenance completeness (100%) are demonstrated structurally, while task-metric optimization and memory ablation effects are explicitly bounded as secondary or case-specific findings [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0053, Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0072]. Limitations regarding short budgets, reset issues, and lack of human user studies are transparently disclosed [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0074].
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation spans 1,445 trials across six diverse benchmark nodes ranging from synthetic regression to GPU-based language model training [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0007, Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0054]. It validates governance guarantees via matched ungoverned counterfactuals, reset integrity hashing, memory ablations, and structural relabeling agreement (kappa = 0.830) [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0048, Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0058].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: An independent rule-based structural relabeler tested on observable ledger fields demonstrated high agreement (Cohen's kappa = 0.830) with control-plane failure categorizations, and matched ungoverned runs corroborated ledger completeness differences [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0048, Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0058].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Control-plane governance metrics (provenance completeness, invalid rate, failure categorization, and counterfactual ledger retention) alongside objective benchmark task scores [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0033, Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0046].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Pre-run guard checks, execution status, and objective validation task metrics (such as validation AUC or bits-per-byte) evaluated against the current best to decide keep, discard, or fail states [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0018, Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0031].

primary.limitations: The manuscript explicitly details the descriptive nature of memory ablation orderings across tasks, reset protocol anomalies in earlier runs, the unverified root cause of total worker failure on the autoresearch node, and the absence of a multi-rater human audit study [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0070, Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0074].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology clearly separates proposal generation (manager), execution (worker), and governance authority (control plane) using enforceable invariants, pre-run and post-run guards, and an append-only JSONL ledger [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0018, Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0027]. The taxonomy of failure modes and lifecycle transitions are thoroughly operationalised and tested via deterministic probes and recovery paths [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0029, Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0047].
primary.quality_rationale: The paper provides an exceptionally rigorous, well-engineered, and transparently characterized framework for auditing autonomous ML experimentation agents. By focusing on governance, auditability, and failure classification rather than merely reporting peak task scores, it makes a substantial methodological contribution supported by solid empirical evidence and reproducible open artifacts.
primary.scoped_contribution: A governed harness and evaluation protocol for autonomous LLM-driven ML experimentation that enforces lifecycle state transitions, bounded edit scopes, independent deterministic adjudication, and append-only ledger provenance across trials [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0007, Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0021].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The paper provides an exceptionally rigorous, well-engineered, and transparently characterized framework for auditing autonomous ML experimentation agents. By focusing on governance, auditability, and failure classification rather than merely reporting peak task scores, it makes a substantial methodological contribution supported by solid empirical evidence and reproducible open artifacts.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The manuscript explicitly details the descriptive nature of memory ablation orderings across tasks, reset protocol anomalies in earlier runs, the unverified root cause of total worker failure on the autoresearch node, and the absence of a multi-rater human audit study [Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0070, Ea71b3056d68a691d-B0074].
